units.source_text: 古歌：“除却使君外，何人能赏心？

en.t: An old poem says: Apart from you, my lord, who else could truly appreciate my heart?

units.source_text: 梅花香色好，惟汝是知音。”

en.t: The plum blossoms are lovely in fragrance and color; only you understand them as a true kindred spirit.
This appears in the Kokin Wakashu.
